_comment: The content-pack registry (frontend/modules/contentPacks). Hand-kept: one row per directory under frontend/packs/. The seedling and archipelago packs are GENERATED by scripts/procgen/extract-seedling-art-packs.mjs (whose --check refuses a pack this file does not list); a hand-made pack (a reskin) is added here by hand. `graphics` names the pack stack the Seedling JS runtime page loads for ?graphics=<id>, in override order (a later pack wins per key). `sfx` names the sound-effect stacks the same way (frontend/modules/sfxLibrary), and `music` the music stacks (frontend/modules/musicLibrary). `content` names the CONTENT SETS (themes): the stacks whose `concepts` and `text` layers a world's characters, places, objects and prose resolve from (frontend/modules/packConcepts, frontend/modules/textLibrary). A substrate's DEFAULT pack (its registry entry's `defaultContentPack`, e.g. text-adventure, maze) is in every world's stack without being named here; this table names only the themes a world may add.

packs.title: Seedling — the original graphics, sound effects and music
Archipelago — the fork's AP item pickup
